verses.1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, by the will of God, according to the prophecy of life in Christ Jesus.
verses.2: To Timotheus, my beloved son; may grace, mercy, and peace be with you from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.3: I bless the God I worship, who has been my deity since ancient times, with pure devotion. I will always remember Him in my prayers, night and day.
verses.4: I hope to see you again, remembering those gifts for you, so that I can be filled with joy.
verses.5: Remembering the faith that you possess, which was first established in your mother Loida and your father Eunike, I believe that it also exists in you as well.
verses.6: I ask you to remember the reason for this: it is because of the gift of God. It lies within you, through the touch of my hands.
verses.7: For the God did not give us the spirit of slavitude, but strength, love, and wisdom.
verses.8: So, do not be deceived by the testimony of our lord, nor by his bonds. Instead, rejoice in the gospel with the power of God.
verses.9: To him who saved us and called us with holy names, not according to our own actions, but out of a personal intention and grace. The gift that was given to us in Christ Jesus, long ago.
verses.10: Now, it has become clear through the appearance of our Savior, Jesus Christ. He not only destroyed death but also brought life and salvation through the gospel.
verses.11: To whom I have served as an apostle and teacher.
verses.12: I know the reason why I suffer all these things, but I don’t mind. I know who it is that I can trust to keep my promise on that day.
verses.13: Let it be a model for healthy words, those which you have heard from me, with faith and love in Jesus Christ.
verses.14: Protect the good pledge through the spirit of the holy one who dwells within us.
verses.15: You know that I have been rejected by everyone in Asia. Those who are from Asia include Phygelos and Hermogenes.
verses.16: The Lord’s kindness towards the homeless man was truly wonderful. He comforted me many times, and he never neglected my needs at all.
verses.17: But when I arrived in Jerusalem, I was sought after with great enthusiasm. And I was found.
verses.18: May the Lord find mercy for him from the Lord on that day. And whatever He did in Ephèse, you should do better than that.
